title: Restriction compatibility of the specified local stalk class map
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $y\in Y$, $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $p\in\mathbf N$. Put $c:Y_1=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to Y$, $X_1=Y_1\times_Y X$, $f_1:X_1\to Y_1$, $g_1:X_1\to X$ and $F_1=g_1^*F$. The specified class map $b:H^p(X_1,F_1)\to(c_*R^p f_{1*}F_1)_y$ is [def-weil-pbc-local-direct-image-stalk-class-map]. For every injective resolution $I$ of $F$, $K$ of $F_1$, open $V\ni y$ and choices $D$ of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], put $W=g_1^{-1}(f^{-1}V)$ and let $r:H^p(X_1,F_1)\to H^p(W,F_1|_W)$ be the map of the restriction unit from [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. Then for every global class $\eta$, $b(\eta)=\operatorname{germ}_{V,y}(D.\mathrm{targetClass}_p(r(\eta)))$, where targetClass is the resolution class construction in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction].

source.place: Lemma 20.7.3 (Tag 01E4), canonical presheaf-to-higher-direct-image map and restrictions; Remark 20.14.2 (Tag 01FB), augmented resolution computation.

proof.text: Apply localDirectImage_stalk_class_top_comparison to compute the defined local class as the top germ of the class from the supplied target resolution K. This uses no restricted resolution.
Apply D.targetClass_restriction with the same supplied K, eta, y and hy. It identifies the top-open germ computed with K with the germ of the restricted target class, without changing K.
The middle top-open germ expressions of these two equalities are identical. Transitivity of equality combines them and proves the desired class restriction formula.

proof_origin.place: M2 separates change of resolution (the defined map equals the top-open germ with supplied K) from restriction with that same K (top-open germ equals restricted target germ). The Lean proof combines these two equalities by transitivity.

lean.statement:
theorem localDirectImage_stalk_class_restriction
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (K : InjectiveResolution
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))
    (V : Y.Opens) (hy : y ∈ V)
    (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (Y.fromSpecStalk y) F I K V)
    (eta : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).toRingedSpace p ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫
            (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).appTop).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)) :
    localDirectImage_stalk_class f y F p eta =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
              (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).rightDerived
                p).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj
                  F))).presheaf V y hy (D.targetClass p
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap
          ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).unit.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
                (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)) p eta))
